children: RHB Bank's near-term earnings may face headwinds from weaker treasury income and potential asset quality pressures amid rising inflation, Public Investment Bank analyst Wong Ling Ling says in a note. However, the bank is expected to manage these risks through resilient fundamentals and its three-year corporate strategy, which targets 12% return on equity by 2027, she says. Loan expansion, stronger current and savings account deposits, higher fee-based income and cost discipline are expected to support earnings growth, she adds. Wong believes RHB's strong fundamentals, attractive dividend yields of about 6% and undemanding valuations could support an attractive risk-reward proposition. Public IB initiates coverage on RHB Bank with an outperform rating and 8.60 ringgit target price. Shares are 0.1% lower at 7.64 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
